title: Diffusion starts from noise
summary: Many image models use diffusion. In a simplified view, generation starts with noise and repeatedly changes it toward a picture guided by a request.
introduction: Many image models use diffusion. In a simplified view, generation starts with noise and repeatedly changes it toward a picture guided by a request. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Many image models use diffusion. In a simplified view, generation starts with noise and repeatedly changes it toward a picture guided by a request.

blocks.code:
Start: random-looking pixels
Repeated step: predict and reduce noise using the model
Guide: description of a paper boat
End: a candidate picture to inspect
blocks.title: Diffusion starts from noise

blocks.text: This is a concept sketch. Real systems use numeric representations and a chosen schedule of steps; they do not reveal a ready-made picture hidden in noise.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
